verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Solstice can to a tiny icon jammed beside the CTA at the bottom. The oversized GLACIER wordmark competes with the headline, and the legal text sits large in the middle as a focal block, so hierarchy and fidelity are broken. B keeps the can at a readable size and the headline dominant, but puts the 'Find a Store' CTA at the top-left before the brand and headline. That reverses the reading order. The logo also sits under the headline, and the bottom is cramped with legal text near the edge.
